$comment: Single source of truth for file ownership. Read by sync.mjs, vendor.mjs, check.mjs and the docs. Paths are repo-relative globs. A path that matches no layer is treated as project-owned.

agentic.description: Owned by this template. sync.mjs may overwrite these paths in a spawned project (tests/agentic/ holds the template's own tests so they follow the scripts they cover). Exceptions: ci.yml is seeded (init fills in the project's check command); template-ci.yml and release.mjs exist only in the template.

vendored.description: Owned by an upstream project. Not shipped by the template: installed per project at the version pinned in vendor.json (checked by vendor.mjs verify), never edited in place. Customisations go in _bmad/custom.

project.description: Owned by the spawned project (tests/** except the synced tests/agentic/**). Never touched by sync, except that sync updates boilerplate.lock (written by init.mjs) to the template version it synced to.

seeded.description: Copied once at spawn time, then owned by the project. Sync never overwrites them.

template-only.description: Exists only in the template repository. init.mjs reads this list and deletes these in a spawned project (`dir/**` removes the whole directory); sync never adds them. Add a path here whenever a file is about the template itself rather than about a project built from it.
